posts.snippet: Closing K12 B2B Sales isn't about cold demos—it's about earning trust with school trustees, academic directors, and multi-school principals before budget cycles lock.
After 18 years as a Principal, here is what K12 B2B Sales teams get wrong when pitching ERP and learning platforms to school management committees.
Scaling K12 B2B Sales across 40+ CBSE and ICSE school chains requires channel advisors who already sit at the boardroom table with school owners.
School groups are consolidating vendor stacks for the 2027 academic session. Practical lessons from leading K12 B2B Sales and school transformation audits.
As a Managing Trustee overseeing 9 K12 campuses, I only take K12 B2B Sales meetings introduced by fellow educators or proven school network consultants.
